3.title: Home Staging
3.description: We stage your property optimally for sale or rental in just 1 day - in Vienna, Lower Austria and Styria

main.html:
Why home staging?

Living in a house or an apartment differs significantly from marketing it.
On the one hand, it is the often very individual interior, and on the other hand, the lack of atmosphere in completely empty properties that turn out to be a hurdle when selling or renting.

main.headline: Only few people can imagine a room changed
main.html:
In empty rooms it is often difficult to assess the proportions correctly.

In furnished properties, the individual style of the current owners is usually too dominant.

main.headline: We create atmosphere
main.html: Home staging emphasises a property's strengths, creates space, develops a lighting and colour concept, gives every room a clear function and "neutralises" through the targeted reduction of personal items and the addition of suitable rental furniture, accessories and lighting.

1. Initial contact and viewing

You send us the floor plan of the property, some photos and the address. After an initial personal conversation, we view the property, take photographs and provide a first cost estimate.

2. Detailed offer

The type and size of the property as well as the target group determine the scope of sensible HOME STAGING measures. You will receive a detailed offer from us with a cost overview and a possible staging date.

3. Execution

After you commission us, we organise all the necessary preparatory work and stage the entire property with the whole team in just one day. The professional photographs – or an individual video if you like – are ready for marketing the very next day.

4. The quality of our stagings

We pay attention to the high quality of our stagings and repeatedly surprise our customers with different productions. Every property is furnished with an individual mix of real furniture, carpets and accessories that naturally suits the target group! On average we deliver 80 to 150 pieces. Every light outlet is fitted with lamps. Cardboard furniture is only found in the kitchen with us!

5. Marketing period

(Will you collect the furniture right after the photos?)

The furniture, accessories and lighting remain in the property for the entire marketing period – at least 2 months. This is also the advantage of a real HOME STAGING compared to virtual staging, where the prospective buyer sees beautiful pictures but the viewing takes place in an empty property.

6. After the sale / after the rental

Once a buyer or tenant has been found, a single phone call is all it takes and all furniture, lamps and accessories will be dismantled and collected again.

An investment that pays off

As a rule, the cost of a home staging including all rental furniture and accessories amounts to 1 – 2 % of the sale price – depending on location, standard and condition of the property. This investment pays off for every type of property – whether a 2-room apartment, detached house or luxury penthouse – through a significantly shorter selling time and usually also a better sale price.

4.title: Redesign
4.description: Re-stage what you have with furniture, lighting and great accessories - from concept to implementation, all from one hand - for your very own dream home

main.headline: Not happy with your living environment?
main.html:
Our offer is aimed at anyone who wants to change their living environment but is not quite sure what and how. Adapting rooms to new needs, creating new perspectives, zoning areas, using what you have and combining it with new pieces, adding something special.

Fresh, innovative, with that certain something.

The WOHNFEE interior professionals support you in redesigning your own living spaces. We help you define your ideas and implement them either all at once or "step by step".

This service is also recommended when moving into a new home – because with an overall concept you have a great decision-making aid for buying furniture, and your individual, cosy home won't take long to arrive.

main.headline: Redesign by the WOHNFEE professionals
main.html:
The WOHNFEE analyses the conditions of your living spaces and clarifies the wishes, ideas and needs of all residents in a personal conversation. From this, an individual design concept is created with colours, materials, lighting, furniture and accessories.

Implementation from a single source - fairy service, so to speak.

The offer includes the entire redesign of the interior spaces. We plan and organise all the necessary things. If structural alterations are also required, we work with selected architecture firms.

Properties of any size are changed for you – according to budget specifications and cost estimate – exactly as you dream of. No standard package, but something special.

1. Initial contact and viewing

You send us the floor plan of the property, some photos and the address. In a first personal meeting on site, we clarify all your wishes together and the possibilities for implementation

2. Furnishing concept

We create a moodboard for you that captures the style, colours and materials. Then, room by room, colours, furniture, lighting, rugs and accessories are illustrated – of course also happily incorporating existing pieces of furniture. This concept is then discussed with you once more and refined in detail.

3. Implementation

Depending on whether you want to implement everything at once or prefer to go "piece by piece" – we will gladly plan the possible steps for you. After you commission us, we organise all the necessary preparatory work and will happily also order all the proposed furniture. If you prefer to shop yourself, that is of course no problem either – then you will receive a list with all product links and, if you like, the contacts of the professionals.

4. Budget and schedule

After the initial on-site assessment, we draw up a first cost framework. Then the individual details are discussed, samples are organised and a rough schedule is created. We always make sure to stay within the given budget. A good mix in furnishing is important to us: high-quality basic pieces (seating furniture, lighting, storage furniture) and more affordable accessories, vintage one-offs if desired – after all, it should become your individual, cosy home where you feel completely at ease.

An investment that pays off

The cost of a redesign consultation or even a complete redesign "from WOHNFEE's hand" is definitely worth it – because the many hours you would spend searching for suitable materials, furniture, lighting etc. are taken off your hands. You make the final selection – according to your specifications, of course – but enhanced with the professional tips of WOHNFEE. And you can then already enjoy the time you have saved in your new home.

main.headline: Privacy Policy
main.html:
Last updated: October 2026. Protecting your personal data is very important to us. We process your data exclusively on the basis of the statutory provisions (GDPR, Austrian Data Protection Act, Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021). This page informs you about the most important aspects of data processing on our website and in our services.

Controller

For all questions regarding data protection and to exercise your rights, please contact us using the details above.

Visiting the website

When you visit our website, the web server processes technically necessary data: IP address, date and time, the page requested, browser and operating system, and the referring page. This data is required to deliver the website, ensure its security (e.g. protection against misuse by temporarily limiting requests per IP address) and fix errors. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

The website is hosted by [to be completed: hosting provider, registered office/server location], with whom a data processing agreement has been concluded. Server logs are deleted after [to be completed: number] days. Fonts, images and scripts are loaded from our own server – merely visiting the site does not transfer any data to Google Fonts or other third parties.

Contacting us

If you contact us via the contact form, e-mail or phone, we process the information you provide (name, e-mail address, phone number if applicable, subject and message) in order to answer your inquiry and, where applicable, prepare an offer. To protect against spam, we additionally store a non-reversible hash of your IP address. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) or our legitimate interest in answering inquiries (Art. 6(1)(f)). If no contract is concluded, we delete the data after six months.

Furniture leasing: rental request, offer and contract

For a rental request via our rental shop, we process your contact details (name, company if applicable, e-mail address, phone number), the delivery address, rental start and duration, the selected furniture and your delivery notes. We need this data to check availability and transport, reserve the selected furniture for you and prepare an offer (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The contents of your cart are stored only locally in your browser until you submit the request.

Online offer: You receive your offer by e-mail with a personal, non-guessable link that lets you view it, download it as a PDF and accept or decline it. Anyone who knows the link can view the offer – please do not share it. If you accept, we store the name you enter together with the date and time as proof of the conclusion of the contract; if you decline, we store any reason you choose to give. If an offer remains unanswered, you will receive one reminder by e-mail.

Delivery, assembly and collection are carried out by our own team. We transfer invoice data to our tax advisor where this is necessary to fulfil tax obligations. Data from concluded contracts is retained for the statutory retention period (7 years, Section 132 Austrian Federal Fiscal Code) (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR). Requests that do not lead to a contract are deleted after six months.

Calculating transport costs (OpenStreetMap)

To calculate the distance and travel time to your delivery address and thus the transport costs, our server transmits only the address (street, postcode, city, country) – without your name or any other personal details – to the following services:

  • Nominatim (converting the address into coordinates) of the OpenStreetMap Foundation, St John’s Innovation Centre, Cowley Road, Cambridge, CB4 0WS, United Kingdom. The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the United Kingdom.
  • OSRM (route calculation): only coordinates are transmitted, no address. The project’s public server is operated by [to be completed: verify OSRM server operator – according to the project FOSSGIS e.V., Germany].

We cache the results so that the same address is not queried again. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in an accurate, transparent price calculation (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Sending e-mails

We send e-mails (offers, reminders, confirmations, newsletters) via [to be completed: e-mail/SMTP provider, registered office]. A data processing agreement has been concluded with the provider.

Newsletter

For the newsletter we only need your e-mail address and your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, Section 174 Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021). We use the double opt-in procedure: after signing up you receive an e-mail with a confirmation link; only then is the subscription active. As proof, we store the time of registration and confirmation as well as a hash of your IP address. The newsletter is managed on our own system; no external newsletter service is used.

You can unsubscribe at any time via the unsubscribe link in every issue or by e-mail to office@wohnfee.at. Your data will then be blocked for mailing or deleted.

Cookies and local storage

To operate the website, we use your browser’s local storage for technically necessary functions: cart and favourites in the rental shop, the selected language and your cookie settings. This data remains on your device and is only transmitted to us when you submit a request. The legal basis is Section 165(3) Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021 (strictly necessary for the service you requested).

Anything that is not strictly necessary is only loaded after you consent. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time via the cookie settings in the footer of the website.

Web analytics (Google Analytics)

Only if you consent in the cookie settings do we use Google Analytics provided by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. Cookies are set and information about your use of the website (e.g. pages viewed, time spent, device type) is transmitted to Google with a shortened IP address. A transfer to the USA is possible; Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, Section 165(3) Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021), which you can withdraw at any time with effect for the future.

Embedded videos and social networks

In some posts we embed YouTube videos (Google Ireland Limited) in privacy-enhanced mode. A connection to YouTube is only established when you start a video, at which point data (including your IP address) may be transmitted to Google.

We link to our profiles on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn using simple links only. No data is transferred to these networks when you visit our website; the privacy policies of the respective provider only apply once you click a link.

Your rights

You generally have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time with effect for the future. Please contact office@wohnfee.at.

If you believe that the processing of your data violates data protection law, you can lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. In Austria this is the Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde), Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, dsb@dsb.gv.at.

main.headline: The recognition value of your properties
main.html: Set your company apart from the competition and let your customers experience viewings in beautiful show homes even during the construction phase. Furnished rooms can be perceived much better in terms of their size and function. Beautiful furniture, appealing decoration and lighting clearly highlight the advantages of your property!

main.headline: Your advantages
main.html: With a WOHNFEE home staging you increase the recognition value of your properties! Marketing times are shortened and price reductions avoided. Here you will find examples of show apartments in shell constructions and completed residential complexes, as well as an example of a converted construction container used as a sales room and office.

Your competitive edge

Use home staging for your business and benefit from competitive advantages over your rivals!
As an innovative property presentation, home staging successfully supports your work as an estate agent.

By upgrading the property and equipping it for your target group, you generate significantly more demand.
Professional photos also ensure a high-quality presentation and, as a result, a high number of online views of your listing.

Our experience

WOHNFEE home staging demonstrably leads to faster purchase decisions by prospective buyers and thus to fewer viewing appointments until the sale. We have particularly good experience with properties that have difficult floor plans or many sloping ceilings!

The financing of a home staging is usually provided by the owner of the property. So as an agent, you take no financial risk.

You take care of the sale, we take care of the rest!

The first impression counts!

Anyone who has ever been looking for an apartment knows the situation: in a completely empty property it is difficult to estimate room sizes or imagine the furnishing. It is even harder in a property fully packed with the previous owner's belongings. 8 out of 10 prospective buyers feel exactly the same way.

main.headline: We spark interest
main.html: Not even advice such as 'you just have to imagine it all completely differently...' helps. The decision has usually already been made – and it is against the property. In order to appeal to the widest possible range of buyers, we present your property in a neutral and modern way - with rental furniture, decoration and beautiful lighting. The perfect photos after the home staging also increase interest in your property on the property portals.

31.title: FAQ
31.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about home staging, process, costs, furniture leasing and redesign – WOHNFEE, location-independent thanks to our own transport service.

children.headline: What is home staging?
children.html:
Home staging prepares a property specifically for sale or rental. We emphasise the strengths of the rooms, develop a lighting and colour concept, give every room a clear function and complete everything with suitable rental furniture, rugs, accessories and lighting.

This allows prospective buyers and tenants to imagine themselves living there straight away during the viewing.

children.headline: What are the benefits of home staging?
children.html:
In a nutshell, sellers and agents benefit from

  • Perfect photo or even video material for advertising
  • Fewer viewing appointments
  • Up to 50 % shorter selling time
  • The best possible sale price
  • Satisfied customers

children.headline: Where does WOHNFEE work?
children.html: We work regardless of location: with our own transport service we deliver, assemble and collect flexibly wherever your property is. Since 2011 we have been staging properties of all sizes and styles.

children.headline: Is home staging also worthwhile for occupied or furnished properties?
children.html: Yes. In furnished properties, the individual style of the current owners is often too dominant. We “neutralise” by reducing personal items in a targeted way and adding suitable rental furniture, accessories and lighting – so the property appeals to the widest possible target group.

children.headline: What is the difference to virtual staging?
children.html:
If a property is still being planned, virtual staging can be very helpful. Staging existing properties “live”, however, creates a tangible experience during the viewing: you sit on the sofa or at the dining table, the rooms no longer echo, it feels cosy.

With virtual staging, prospective buyers see beautiful pictures – but the viewing then takes place in an empty property. One WOHNFEE customer put it in a nutshell: you can’t compare a concert on TV with a live concert!

children.headline: How does a home staging work?
children.html:
1. Initial contact: You send us the floor plan, some photos and the address.
  2. Viewing: After a personal conversation, we view the property and give a first cost estimate.
  3. Offer: You receive a detailed offer with a cost overview and a possible staging date.
  4. Staging: We stage the entire property in just one day.
  5. Marketing: Furniture and accessories remain on site during marketing.
  6. Collection: Once a buyer or tenant has been found, we collect everything again.

More about the process

children.headline: How quickly can the staging be carried out?
children.html: From the viewing to implementation we need – depending on the size of the property – 1–2 weeks. The actual staging is done in one day. The professional photos – or an individual video if you like – are ready for marketing the very next day.

children.headline: Which documents do you need from me?
children.html: For a first assessment, the floor plan, a few photos of the rooms and the address of the property are sufficient. We clarify everything else in a personal conversation and during the viewing.

children.headline: How long does the furniture stay in the property?
children.html: The furniture, lamps and accessories remain in the property for the entire marketing period. Our package prices are based on a rental period of 3 months. That is the big difference to a visualisation – the feeling of living there can be experienced at every viewing.

children.headline: What happens after the sale or rental?
children.html: Once a buyer or tenant has been found, a single phone call is all it takes: we dismantle all furniture, lamps and accessories and collect them again.

children.headline: How much does home staging cost?
children.html:
As a rule, the cost of a home staging including all rental furniture and accessories is 1–2 % of the sale price – depending on location, standard and condition of the property. For residential units up to 50, 70 and 100 m² there are packages with “from” prices; we prepare the final offer individually for your property.

To the price packages

children.headline: Which services are included in the price?
children.html:
Our service includes the concept, the selection of furniture, the organisation of transport and tradespeople and the staging on site. We prepare an individual offer for every property depending on the target group and rental period.

Lamp installation is not included. All prices plus 20 % VAT.

children.headline: How is payment made?
children.html: We charge a 50 % deposit, the remainder is due after the staging. All prices plus 20 % VAT.

children.headline: Are the lamps installed as well?
children.html: Lamp installation is not included in our prices. It has to be carried out by the client or agreed individually with us.

children.headline: Is it real furniture?
children.html:
Yes. Every property is furnished with an individual mix of real furniture, rugs and accessories that suits the target group. Every light outlet is fitted with lamps.

We only use cardboard furniture in the kitchen (a dummy kitchen adapted to the available space). In the bedroom we use a dummy bed with bedspread, cushions, throw and valance.

children.headline: Why not simply choose a cheaper staging?
children.html:
A staging that is too cheap and does not match the target group can be a disadvantage for the sale or rental.

WOHNFEE plans furniture, lighting, rugs and accessories to suit the target group – on average we deliver 80 to 150 pieces per property. Of course, this has a completely different effect than “a bit of decoration”. When comparing offers, look for the most detailed description of the furnishings possible.

children.headline: Who pays for the home staging if I am an estate agent?
children.html:
A home staging is usually financed by the owner of the property. As an agent, you therefore take no financial risk. You take care of the sale, we take care of the rest!

Home staging for estate agents

children.headline: Do you also furnish show flats and sales rooms?
children.html:
Yes. We furnish show flats in shell constructions and finished residential complexes and have even converted a site container into a sales room and office. This lets your customers experience the size and function of the rooms during the construction phase.

Home staging for property developers

children.headline: Does home staging help with difficult floor plans?
children.html: We have had particularly good experiences with properties with difficult floor plans or many sloping ceilings. In empty rooms it is often difficult to assess the proportions correctly – once furnished, size and function become clear immediately.

children.headline: Can I also rent furniture independently of a staging?
children.html:
Yes – with furniture leasing you rent high-quality furniture and accessories flexibly for 1 month up to several years, for example for temporary living solutions. The longer the rental period, the better the conditions. We deliver, assemble and collect; the one-off delivery/collection fee is shown in the offer.

To furniture leasing

children.headline: What is a redesign?
children.html:
Our redesign is aimed at everyone who wants to change their own home. We analyse the rooms, create a mood board and an individual design concept with colours, materials, lighting, furniture and accessories – also including existing pieces of furniture. Implementation takes place all at once or step by step; if conversions are necessary, we work with selected architecture firms.
